title: Longest Field Goals in NFL History 🏈 Nobody Has Hit 70… Yet #NFL #shorts
description:
The longest field goals in NFL regular-season history: Cam Little's 68-yarder for the Jacksonville Jaguars against the Las Vegas Raiders (2 November 2025) is the record, ahead of Little's 67 against Tennessee (January 2026) and Justin Tucker's 66-yard game-winner for the Baltimore Ravens at Detroit in 2021. Brandon Aubrey, Chase McLaughlin and Matt Prater also have kicks of 64 yards or more. On Thanksgiving 2026, Jake Elliott (59) and Tyler Bass (57) won games with long kicks at the end.

title: Biggest Thanksgiving Comeback Ever | Eagles vs Cowboys 39–38 😱 #NFL #shorts
description:
The Philadelphia Eagles came back from 21 points down to beat the Dallas Cowboys 39–38 on Thanksgiving 2026, the biggest blown lead in Thanksgiving history. A year earlier, on 23 November 2025, Dallas had come back from 21–0 down to beat Philadelphia 24–21. The Chicago Bears also rallied from 11 points down in the fourth quarter to beat Detroit 39–35, joining the 1962 New York Titans and the 1980 Bears as the only teams to win on Thanksgiving after trailing by 11 or more in the fourth.

description:

DeVonta Smith caught 11 passes for 200 yards and two touchdowns, and Jake Elliott won it with a 59-yard field goal.
